titulo: Severe Post‐Tuberculosis Bronchiectasis With Bullous Lung Disease Complicated by Acute Infective Exacerbation: A Case Report From Uganda

fig.label: FIGURE 2
fig.caption: Axial chest CT images demonstrating extensive bilateral structural lung disease consistent with post‐tuberculosis sequelae. (A) Cystic bronchiectasis with clustered dilated airways showing a signet ring appearance. (B) Tram‐track appearance of bronchiectasis with thickened dilated bronchi. (C) Large bullae, more prominent in the right lung.
